query: Consider the Confidentiality Agreement between QEP and BMO; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold:
The Confidential Information shall remain the property of Owner, and the written Confidential Information, except for that portion of the Confidential Information that is contained in analyses, compilations, studies or other documents prepared by or for the Receiving Company in connection with the Transaction, shall be destroyed or returned to Owner immediately upon its request, and no copies shall be retained by the Receiving Company or its Representatives, unless the Parties agree otherwise; provided, however, that any Confidential Information contained in back-up computer records may be retained for such period required for compliance purposes if required by law, rule or regulation; provided further, that such Confidential Information shall continue to be subject to the confidentiality, non-disclosure and non-use obligations contained in this Agreement until returned in accordance with this Section 6.
The Receiving Company’s obligation to maintain the Confidential Information confidential as provided in this Agreement shall survive any decision by Owner not to proceed with the Transaction, or to proceed with a party other than the Receiving Company.
14. Term. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement to the contrary, this Agreement shall be effective as of the Effective Date and shall remain in full force and effect thereafter for a period of one year, whereupon this Agreement shall automatically terminate, unless otherwise terminated by the mutual written agreement of the Parties. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Section 6 will survive termination of this Agreement until such time as Receiving Party and its Representatives have destroyed all Confidential Information retained in accordance with Section 6, and the remaining Sections of this Agreement will survive termination of this Agreement until such time and to the extent necessary to enforce or give full force and effect the obligations set forth in Section 6.
rag_answer:
Yes. The document expressly provides that certain obligations survive termination.

Specifically, **Section 14 (Term)** states that although the Agreement automatically terminates after one year, **Section 6 will survive termination** until the Receiving Party and its Representatives have destroyed or returned all Confidential Information, and the **remaining Sections will survive termination** to the extent necessary to enforce or give full force and effect to the obligations in Section 6.

Additionally, **Section 9** states that the Receiving Company’s obligation to maintain Confidential Information confidential **survives any decision by Owner not to proceed with the Transaction** or to proceed with another party.

judge.gold_summary: 金标明确说明协议终止后部分义务仍存续：Section 6 在接收方及其代表销毁/返还全部保密信息前继续有效；其余条款为执行 Section 6 义务而在必要范围内继续有效；同时接收方维持保密信息的义务在 Owner 决定不进行或另选交易方时仍存续。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答确认文档提及义务在终止后存续，并具体说明 Section 14 中 Section 6 在保密信息被销毁/返还前继续有效，其余条款为执行 Section 6 义务继续有效；还提到接收方保密义务在 Owner 决定不进行或另选交易方时存续。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论，即协议终止后 Section 6 及相关执行义务继续存续，以及保密义务在特定交易决策情形下存续；虽补充了 Section 9 编号且未展开备份记录等细节，但不影响命中。
